limitations: Random overlapping-window validation, used for epoch/model selection
No independent recording or unseen-condition test
Conditional motor identification is separate from successful attack detection
Common configurations match attacked-motor labels; unreported settings of the other motor are not controlled by this subset
Per-condition results report recall only, because normal speed/load metadata are zero
Stored onset labels do not establish attack persistence or event-level detection delay

onset_summary.interpretation: The binary detector is stratified by ground-truth onset labels; this does not evaluate the onset head or measure event-level detection delay.
